decisions.reason: Attributes the failure to fs-ext@2.1.1, exactly pinned by dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, whose node-gyp configure build install script fails at the VS/MSVC find step, grounded in install-error.log and manifest-excerpt.json.
Uses the top-level static flock import to show --ignore-scripts leaves an unbuilt native entry that fails at module load, so the service cannot boot.

Clearly separates the Windows named-semaphore path (acquireLockHandleWin32/CreateSemaphoreW) from POSIX flock, treats fs-ext as unused on Windows, and requires Linux/macOS to keep the native build and real flock.

pnpm patch on fs-ext@2.1.1: platform-aware install script, try/catch entry with a loadable pure-JS flock placeholder keeping the export surface, registered in pnpm-workspace.yaml with build-allowlist handling, plus install/module-load/boot/non-Windows verification steps.
No Visual Studio, no upstream repo or published-package change; the repository-local patch is correctly framed as the sanctioned mechanism.
Cites full card DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 and connects it to this fs-ext install failure and the pnpm-patch Windows fix, including a corroborating troubleshooting row.

caps.reason: Installing VS is only a rejected alternative; the plan requires no toolchain.
--ignore-scripts is rejected with the static-import argument; the plan makes the entry loadable.
Fix is a repository-local pnpm patch; the upstream packaging change is cited only as a later strategic follow-up.
Windows keeps the named semaphore; the fallback placeholder never arbitrates locks and POSIX retains the native build.
